title: ageratina haageana
intro: Ageratina haageana, commonly known as Mexican mint, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, that contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. Additionally, Ageratina haageana has been used in traditional medicine to treat digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems, although more research is needed to confirm its efficacy.
